items.q: Do I need to change my streaming infrastructure?
items.a: No! RadioOS connects to your existing stream (Icecast, Shoutcast, AzuraCast, HLS). You keep your current infrastructure.

items.q: How many listeners can I have?
items.a: The Starter plan supports up to 100 simultaneous listeners. The Professional plan supports 1,000 listeners. The Enterprise plan is unlimited.
Yes! We support FCFA payments via Mobile Money (Orange Money, Wave, MTN) and credit cards.
No, you can cancel your subscription at any time. The Starter plan is free and without commitment.

items.q: How does AI work for podcasts?
items.a: AI analyzes your audio file and automatically generates the title, description, chapters and keywords. You can edit everything before publishing.
